{{Quote|The New Order has never fallen. Only the Emperor. &hellip; The Emperor may be dead, but the Empire lives on!|Ardus Kaine|<ref name="TPA" />}}
Following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] declared [[Gender/Legends|himself]] a [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]], seeing it as an opportunity and set about creating his own '''faction''' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], where it soon [[Pentastar Alignment Treaty|joined]] with local leaders from the [[Velcar Free Commerce Zone]] and established the [[Pentastar Alignment]], an isolationist corporatist [[Politics/Legends|government]].<ref name="TPA">{{JournalCite|3|The Pentastar Alignment}}</ref>
